post:
Stop going to the photo booth for ID photos.
Upload any portrait to ChatGPT, type one short code, and get a print-ready sheet of 8.

Plus 3 more codes for fixing and colourizing old photos. Same 3 steps for all of them:

→ Open ChatGPT.
→ Upload your photo.
→ Type the code. Nothing else.

1. /passport whitebg
Any portrait you already have becomes an ID photo on the official white background.

2. /passport8copy
The full print sheet. 8 ID photos.

3. /restore
For that old family photo that's damaged or torn.
It removes the scratches, folds and tears. The photo comes back sharp, like new.

4. /colour
Send the same old photo again (black and white).
ChatGPT adds realistic colours. It looks like it was taken last year.

Below: /passport8copy and /colour typed in ChatGPT, then the actual results.

Save this for the next time you need an ID photo or find an old print in a drawer.

Which one are you trying first: ID photo, restore or colour?
firstFix: Item 1 repeats the hook almost word for word ("Turns any portrait into an ID photo with the official white background."). Add something new instead, like "Works on any portrait, even a casual selfie," or cut the line and keep only the code.

visuals.why: The exact code /passport8copy typed in the ChatGPT box with the portrait attached, readable at a glance.
The payoff: a clean sheet of 8 ID photos ready to print.
The /colour code typed under a black and white photo, so the next image lands.
The same old portrait in realistic colour, a before/after people stop on.
